lead: Competitive activity across aviation EFB, dispatch, and crew operations providers shows steady customer adoption and product iteration, anchored by major airline contracts and platform enhancements throughout the rolling year.

insights.title: IFS Secures Multiple LCC and Regional Airline Wins
insights.finding: IFS captured multiple EFB platform adoptions, including fastjet selecting IFS EFBOne for its Embraer 145 fleet and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) adopting the platform.
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is classified as an African low-cost carrier (LCC), and MY FREIGHTER / Centrum Air is classified as an LCC.
insights.caveat: Captured feed visibility represents monitored announcements rather than total market share.

insights.title: Aviobook Signs Five-Year Agreement with Royal Air Maroc
insights.finding: Thales (Aviobook) secured a five-year agreement with Royal Air Maroc to equip its pilots with the AvioBook Flight EFB platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc is a full-service flag carrier.
insights.caveat: Vendor-specific capture representing one signed contract event in the period.

insights.title: Jeppesen Expands ForeFlight Capabilities with AI and Hardware Support
insights.finding: Jeppesen introduced ForeFlight Airflow to integrate AI into flight operations and added full support for the Apple iPhone Duo via OzRunways.
insights.caveat: Feature announcements and product releases indicate ongoing development cadence rather than immediate deployment breadth.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Explores Sale of Lido and NetLine Units
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems is reportedly exploring a sale of its Lido and NetLine business units for approximately €1bn.
insights.caveat: Based on financial press reporting rather than official vendor confirmation.

insights.title: Navblue Expands TransNusa Collaboration for Skywise Products
insights.finding: TransNusa signed for Skywise Core X2 and Skywise Fleet Performance+ to integrate its flight and technical operations.
insights.caveat: Vendor-specific capture representing regional expansion in Indonesia.
